title: Yowie Group Boosts Secured Loan Facility Cap to A$4.5 Million with Keybridge Capital
excerpt: Yowie Group Limited (ASX:YOW) YOW (ASX:YOW) has revealed an updated amendment to its secured working capital loan facility with Keybridge Capital Limited (ASX:KBC) KBC (ASX:KBC) , raising the facility limit from A$4,000,000 to A$4,500,000, excluding capitalised interest.
content:
Yowie Group Limited (ASX:YOW) YOW (ASX:YOW) has revealed an updated amendment to its secured working capital loan facility with Keybridge Capital Limited (ASX:KBC) KBC (ASX:KBC) , raising the facility limit from A$4,000,000 to A$4,500,000, excluding capitalised interest.

Key Points

  • Facility limit increased from A$4,000,000 to A$4,500,000, excluding capitalised interest
  • Secured working capital loan facility maintained with Keybridge Capital Limited (ASX:KBC) KBC (ASX:KBC)
  • Facility Agreement initially signed on 15 July 2025 and amended multiple times since
  • Maturity date extended to 30 November 2027 as previously disclosed
  • Additional advances under the Facility Agreement are subject to Keybridge's approval

Details of the Facility Amendment

The latest revision to the Facility Agreement increases the facility limit from A$4,000,000 to A$4,500,000, excluding any capitalised interest. Apart from the enhanced facility limit and maturity date extension, all other key terms of the Facility Agreement remain unchanged. The facility continues to be secured by the company’s granted security to Keybridge, within the boundaries of the ASX Listing Rules. Any further advances under the agreement remain at Keybridge’s discretion.

Background on the Facility Agreement

The Facility Agreement was originally executed on 15 July 2025 and publicly announced on 18 July 2025. Since then, the agreement has undergone several amendments, including a prior increase of the facility limit to A$4,000,000 and an extension of the maturity date to 30 November 2027. This latest amendment marks an additional update to the terms of the existing facility with Keybridge Capital Limited, which is also traded on the ASX under ticker KBC.

Authorisation and Corporate Information

The announcement was authorised for release by the Yowie Board of Directors, chaired by Sulieman Ravell. Yowie Group Limited, ABN 98 084 370 669, is headquartered at 113–115 Bakers Road, Coburg North, VIC 3058. Following this amendment, the secured working capital loan facility with Keybridge Capital Limited remains active, with security arrangements continuing under the Facility Agreement terms, as permitted by the ASX Listing Rules.
